name: pythermocalcdb-nasa
description: Agent-ready NASA-7 and NASA-9 thermochemistry for species, reactions, and equilibrium calculations using PyThermoCalcDB-NASA and its MCP interface.

interface.shortDescription: NASA thermochemistry tools for species, reactions, and equilibrium.
interface.longDescription: PyThermoCalcDB NASA connects AI agents to deterministic thermochemical calculations provided by PyThermoCalcDB-NASA through the PyThermoCalcDB-NASA-MCP interface. It supports NASA-7 and NASA-9 workflows, including species heat capacity, enthalpy, entropy, and Gibbs free energy; reaction enthalpy, entropy, and Gibbs free energy; and equilibrium constants. The plugin follows a database-first workflow using the embedded NASA-9 SQLite database, can build ModelSource objects from trusted thermochemical data, and supports externally prepared pyThermoDB reference content when custom or NASA-7 data are required. The MCP layer handles structured validation, ModelSource construction, deterministic function execution, and JSON-safe results, enabling reliable LLM-augmented thermodynamic calculations for chemical engineering, chemistry, and physics-based process modeling.
defaultPrompt: Use the PyThermoCalcDB-NASA MCP tools for deterministic NASA thermochemistry calculations.
Prefer the embedded NASA-9 database when the requested species are available.
Use reference-backed workflows when complete pyThermoDB reference content is provided or NASA-7/custom data are required.
Calculate species Cp, H, S, or G properties with the appropriate MCP species tool.
Calculate reaction thermodynamic properties or equilibrium constants with the appropriate MCP reaction tool.
Validate source availability, temperature range, units, and MCP warnings before reporting scientific results.
